title: Escape arcs, regularity and semi-global solutions
source_hypothesis: Proper scalar classical operator of any real order satisfying P; every characteristic point over K lies in the interior of a compact regular semibicharacteristic interval with no characteristic endpoint over K.
completed_component_scope: Complete compact-support index gain and semi-global existence under condition P and the actual two-ended regular escape-arc condition, all real operator orders, finite or infinite source indices, every strict Sobolev target and one smooth solution. Includes full terminal cap, exact right-input forcing identity and finite strong-minimum argument; the trapped-leaf equivalence remains open.
reviewed_arguments: The original hypothesis is the full two-ended regular semibicharacteristic arc condition of Theorem 26.11.1(i). It includes every characteristic covector over the compact support. The trapped-leaf equivalence remains a separate open receiving obligation.

The local comparison contract checks the full earlier RLP proof: complete homogeneous graph/order reduction, all-frequency gauge, both collapsed and rank-two estimates, actual quotient, full spacetime bracket, every remainder and finite bootstrap. Condition P is not asserted globally for an auxiliary patched symbol.
A complete strong minimum principle follows directly from the circle mean inequality, lower semicontinuity and connectedness. Infinite values away from the finite attained lower bound are permitted.

The terminal homogeneous factor chart has an actual nonextendible interior end, a positive attaching collar and a nonnegative degree-zero cap with compact base support outside K. Rank-two accumulation at a proposed endpoint is handled before choosing an interior rank-one cap.

Homogeneity and rank-one flow uniqueness control projected returns. The explicit Q_new = Re Q + i(1-theta)Im Q preserves the exact real Hamilton tangent on every affected part of the original curve, including returns. Overlapping terminal zero germs use one common factor chart.

Every affected fiber has both positive faces in its one factor chart; its whole zero interval is retained. Unchanged fibers and rank-two singletons use their exact earlier charts. The intrinsic analytic transitions give a connected comparison neighborhood of the entire retained curve.

The full operator correction is A chi, with chi on the input, zero near K and one over the principal correction support. It annihilates every supported distribution exactly. Proper composition preserves the principal cap and all lower terms, so the original forcing is exactly unchanged.

A compact distribution has a finite negative Sobolev order and an attained finite minimum whenever the target bound fails. A strict finite comparison level mu is chosen even for infinite forcing index; no source membership at its index supremum is assumed.

The noncharacteristic case uses the exact intrinsic incoming orientation and both possible ends of a maximal zero component. The all-rank-one case uses the full compact constant-comparison theorem, including radial curves and repeated projected points.

The rank-two case uses the infimum over the whole compact fiber, the exact unchanged forcing, local superharmonic comparison and a finite strong minimum. A new rank-two singleton outside K has infinite unknown index and contradicts the constant minimum.

Conjugation gives identical real Hamiltonians and escape arcs for the adjoint. The proved neighborhood stability and strict finite-cover Fourier argument discharge SL1 for all real r and positive epsilon. The earlier complete finite-obstruction and all-seminorm smooth proofs now give actual semi-global solutions under the original arc condition.

Three complete solutions check the exact cap, the distinction between quasi-concavity and the superharmonic minimum principle, and the necessity of a right input cutoff for a nonlocal operator. Thirty-three finite checks verify only their stated exact algebraic identities.

All 229 formulas and 22 numbered displays parse. Eleven desktop captures, the full exact figure and two mobile samples were inspected. No new source-page previews were generated; prior inspected pages and unchanged source hashes were reused.

The full native goal remains active. The complete trapped-leaf equivalence, its stationary/radial conventions and every remaining HIII21/23/24 and HIV25/26 requirement still need their exact receiving and completion audits. Human foundations remain external.
